Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase. The players are out in the middle.
...The Chase...

England Women will be happy too. They were tight with the ball and didn't gave away too much easily. The spinners got a lot of purchase. Sophie Ecclestone and Charlie Dean were superb but so was Lauren Bell and Nat Sciver-Brunt. Now, this looks like a bit below par but the pitch is not straight forward. Let's see hot it goes. Stay tuned.

A decent batting performance from Australia Women. They lost Alyssa Healy early on Beth Mooney with her fifty and along with fine contributions from Ash Gardner and Tahlia McGrath has helped them get to a decent position. Georgia Wareham too played a handy knock but Australia Women would have loved a bit more from her as at one stage even 180 looked possible.
